isolation_limitation_analysis.primary_limitation: Hardware and OS edition support Hyper-V natively, but the Hyper-V optional feature (Microsoft-Hyper-V-All) is currently not enabled in Windows. Enabling it requires elevation (Administrator privileges) and a single system reboot.

evaluated_alternatives.name: Hyper-V Generation 2 VM (Recommended)
evaluated_alternatives.network_isolation_mechanism: Explicitly omit virtual network adapter (zero vNICs attached)
evaluated_alternatives.storage_isolation_mechanism: Read-only SCSI VHDX/ISO for inputs + separate isolated VHDX for outputs
evaluated_alternatives.reproducibility_impact: Zero drift; exact Windows platform match

evaluated_alternatives.name: Windows Sandbox (.wsb)
evaluated_alternatives.reproducibility_impact: Low; ephemeral storage destroyed immediately on exit requiring automated host mapping

evaluated_alternatives.name: WSL 2 / Rootless Linux Container
evaluated_alternatives.reproducibility_impact: Severe platform violation (alters OS from Windows to Linux, breaking Windows Job Object supervisor and reviewed plan digest)

writable_output_disk.type: Fixed or Dynamically Expanding VHDX (10 GB)
writable_output_disk.purpose: Exclusive scratch workspace for runs/A and runs/B
